title: feat(spec)!: a report chart's `seriesBy` that cannot split (single-series type, or the `xAxis` dimension) is refused at authoring time
body:
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoVMTxdBoChiHe1Sf5J2Xcv5)_ Fixes #28424 Clause-②: yes (narrowing) Metadata-protocol: narrowed domain:spec#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibwvHraeucX94Rvvzrk ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么:报表图表的 `seriesBy` 拆分在两种拆不开的写法下,发布前就被 spec 拒收——饼图/环形图/漏斗/树图/桑基这类单系列图,和 `seriesBy` 与 `xAxis` 同一维度。 - 为什么改:这两种写法今天能保存、能发布,业务用户打开报表才看到报错框或每条系列只有一个点的“坏图”;作者应在 `os build`/Studio 保存/`os lint` 时就听到,而且仪表盘早已对同类写法拒收。 - 风险与回滚:收窄,已存的这两种报表会在下次保存/校验时被拒,拒收文案点名改法(换柱状族或去掉 `seriesBy`);仓内示例与夹具零命中。回滚 = 撤这个 PR。 - 先看:`packages/spec/src/ui/report.zod.ts` 的 `checkReportChartSeriesSplit`;`packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.zod.ts` 只是把 `SINGLE_SERIES_CHART_TYPES` 导出;`packages/spec/src/ui/report.test.ts` 末尾新 describe。 - 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/ui/report.test.ts -t "cannot split"`,预期 7 个用例全绿。 - 需要你做的:无,席位落地。 ## What changes `ReportSchema`'s refinement now calls `checkReportChartSeriesSplit` on every non-`joined` report. It refuses `chart.seriesBy` with one `custom` issue at `chart.seriesBy`, in two arms: 1. **Single-series arm.** `chart.type` is in `SINGLE_SERIES_CHART_TYPES` (`pie` / `donut` / `funnel` / `treemap` / `sankey`). The message names the report, the type and the split, and says what to write instead: a bar-family type (`bar` / `column` / `horizontal-bar`) for one bar per split value, or drop `seriesBy`. 2. **Same-dimension arm.** `seriesBy === xAxis`. The message says `seriesBy` must name a different dimension than `xAxis`, or be dropped. The arms are exclusive. On a single-series type the first one answers, since dropping `seriesBy` fixes both. **One source for the type set.** `SINGLE_SERIES_CHART_TYPES` in `dashboard.zod.ts` changes from a module-private `const` to an export, and its docblock now names the report as a reader. `report.zod.ts` imports it, and so does the `seriesBy` `.describe()`. No second list exists. **Where the check sits.** It runs in the report-level `superRefine`, not on `ReportChartSchema`. That gives the `chart.seriesBy` path and the report's name, and it leaves `ReportChartSchema` an unrefined `ChartConfigSchema.extend(...)`. Its downstream `.extend` / `.shape` readers (`ui/packages/types` `SpecReportChartSchema`, `chart.test.ts`) are untouched. **Rider S1 superseded.** S1 named a lint warning in `packages/lint/src/validate-chart-bindings.ts` for `seriesBy === xAxis`. This spec refusal supersedes it, so no lint rule is added. `validateChartBindings` still owns whether `seriesBy` names a dimension the dataset declares, which this schema cannot see. Generated: `api-surface/ui.json` and `export-origins/ui.json` (the new export), plus `content/docs/references/ui/report.mdx` (the `.describe()` text). ## Tests A new describe block, *ReportSchema refuses a chart seriesBy that cannot split*, in `packages/spec/src/ui/report.test.ts`, 7 cases: - `pie`, `donut` and `funnel` with `seriesBy` are refused at `chart.seriesBy` as `custom`. Each message names the report, `type: 'TYPE'`, the split and the bar-family prescription. - `bar` with `seriesBy === xAxis` is refused, and its message says the split must name a different dimension. - Controls: `bar` and `line` with a distinct `seriesBy` parse and keep it. `pie` without `seriesBy` parses. - A joined report carrying a `pie` chart split by its own `xAxis` gets exactly one issue, at `chart` (the existing joined refusal), and none at `chart.seriesBy`. - One source: across every `ChartTypeSchema` member, the set this refusal fires on equals `SINGLE_SERIES_CHART_TYPES`. Lint fixtures: every `seriesBy` fixture in `validate-chart-bindings.test.ts` is `bar` with a distinct split, so none refuses now. No fixture changed. The suite stays green (80/80). ## Acceptance notes - **Existing metadata.** `git grep seriesBy` over `examples/**`, `packages/qa/**` and `ui/**`, plus the hotcrm checkout: every hit is a `bar` with a distinct split. Zero hits on either refused shape, at 5da3a8ce. - **objectui's client-side authoring door.** The Studio report editor runs its own `.shape` mirror, so it keeps accepting these two shapes until it chains a check. The author then meets the refusal at save or publish, the same position the dashboard arm is in. Noted, not filed. - **Commit trailers.** The three `wip(...)` commits at the base of the branch carry no trailer pair. The branch is not `claude/issue-*`, so it is shared under AGENTS.md §3 and was not rewritten. The squash merge drops them. ## Verification All readings are at head `1707dd00` unless noted.
Ablation, one per arm (src-resolved suite, so no build leg). Mutation through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored to the HEAD blob each time. - Single-series arm, anchor `if (typeof type === 'string' && (SINGLE_SERIES_CHART_TYPES …).includes(type)) {` replaced with `if (false) {`. Anchor count went 1 → 0, blob `4c78418e` → `ca603b9e`. Result: 4 failed (pie, donut, funnel, one-source) and 3 passed. Restored, blob equals HEAD. - Same-dimension arm, anchor `if (seriesBy === xAxis) {` replaced with `if (false) {`. Anchor count went 1 → 0, blob → `b4975efc`. Result: 1 failed (same dimension) and 6 passed. Restored, blob equals HEAD.
Package runs - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` (declarations on): VERDICT command-exit 0. - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: 3 stale before `--fix` (api-surface, export-origins, docs). After `--fix`, all 14 are up to date. - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` + `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/validate-chart-bindings.test.ts`: VERDICT command-exit 0, 80/80. - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 773 passed (773), Tests 22837 passed + 1 todo. - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` (owed once for the `(narrowing)` arm, at 1707dd00, closure built first): VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 361 passed + 3 skipped (364), Tests 2917 passed + 28 skipped.
Derived gates (dispatch-gates.mjs --commands, 104 lines, each run with stdin closed, exit captured before any pipe) Prerequisite build first: `turbo run build --filter='./packages/**' --filter='@objectstack/dogfood^...'` with declarations (VERDICT command-exit 0). Then all 104 lines ran, and every one is `:: exit 0`. The `check:entry-nameability` log prints its standing NOT MEASURED line for `api-assembled` / `qa`, which have no callable export; that line is unrelated to this diff. `dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran`: "104 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 104 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 104 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)", exit 0. The record is at `/mnt/project-files/spec-seat-1/r2026-10-31/out/28424-gates-ran-1707dd00.list` in the seat's project folder. Every other family is CI's: see this PR's check-runs.
